sbi.HTML.FailedToImport: Failed to import actor — see browser console for details.
sbi.HTML.NameInputMissing: Name field is empty. Please enter a name.
sbi.parser.EmptyClipboard: Nothing to import — paste a stat block into the text area.
sbi.parser.NotValidStatblock: Text does not look like a valid SWADE stat block. It must contain at least an Attributes: section.
sbi.parser.ClipboardError: Clipboard access denied. Paste the stat block into the text area.
sbi.settings.NumberOfBenniesHint: How many Bennies each NPC Wild Card starts with.
sbi.settings.BulletPointIconsHint: Character(s) used as bullet points for Special Abilities, separated by pipe '|'. Default is the bullet point character.
sbi.settings.ModifiedSpecialAbilitiesHin: Replace bullet points with @sa, @w, @a, @e, @h prefixes to force item type (special ability, weapon, armor, edge, hindrance).
sbi.settings.AllAsSpecialAbilities: Import all Special Abilities as Ability items
sbi.settings.AllAsSpecialAbilitiesHint: When enabled, all entries in Special Abilities are imported as Ability items, skipping automatic weapon/armor detection.
sbi.settings.AutoCalcToughnessHint: Allow the system to recalculate Toughness from Vigor and Armor rather than using the parsed value.
sbi.settings.SetTokenSize: Auto-set token size from creature Size
sbi.settings.SetTokenSizeHint: Automatically set token width/height based on the creature's Size special ability.
sbi.settings.CalculateIgnoredWoundsHint: Automatically set ignored wounds for Undead, Construct, and Elemental creatures.
sbi.settings.CalculateAdditionalWoundsHi: Apply extra max Wounds from Size and Resilient/Very Resilient abilities.
sbi.settings.TwoHandsHint: Pipe-separated strings that mark a weapon as two-handed (e.g. 'two hands|two-handed').
sbi.settings.CompendiumsSelectorHint: Choose which compendiums the importer searches for matching items (edges, skills, powers, gear).
sbi.settings.TokenSettingsHint: Set the default prototype token settings applied to all imported actors.
sbi.settings.SelectPacksInfo: Selecting a package includes all of its Item compendiums.
sbi.settings.AdditionalTraitsHint: Comma-separated list of extra stat block labels to detect (each must be followed by a colon in the stat block, e.g. 'Sanity:, Strain:').
